tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace and return its contents. Use before editing a file you have not seen.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Permanently delete a file. This is irreversible and destructive; call only after explicit user confirmation.

path.description: Path of the file to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true; the user confirmed the deletion.
